optionsAboutBody.message: Canvas Veil adds stable, per-session noise to 2D canvas reads — the protection itself is 100% local. No analytics, no tracking, no data collection. The only network requests are license checks if you choose to activate Pro (verified once, then re-checked at most once a day).

obTitle.message: Protect your canvas with Canvas Veil

obS1B.message: Stop trackers from reading your browser's canvas to fingerprint you. Canvas Veil adds stable noise to those reads, automatically, on every site.

obS2B.message: Every tab session gets its own random seed, so sites never get a stable read. Each site sees one fake identity per session, and repeated reads still match.

obS3B.message: Need a site to see your real canvas? Flip the toggle in the popup. Captcha and checkout pages are auto-excluded, so they keep working.

obS4B.message: Free protects you on every site, forever. A Zovo membership pins a stable identity per site and adds strength presets, stats history, and sync. Two ways in. $4.99/month, cancel anytime. Or $99 once, never pay again · it pays for itself in about 20 months.

obS5T.message: No analytics, no tracking, no data collection.

obS5B.message: One developer builds Canvas Veil in the open, and keeps it open source. Canvas-noise protection stays 100% local; the only network requests are license checks if you choose to activate Pro (at most once a day).

obS6B.message: Browse normally. The toolbar badge keeps count of the noised reads on the current tab.
